items.exampleEn: Her long hair was tangled after the windy walk.
items.exampleZh: 在大風中散步後，她的長髮都打結了。

items.exampleEn: Everyone wore somber colors at the formal ceremony.
items.exampleZh: 正式的典禮上，大家都穿著深暗的顏色。

items.exampleEn: He subtly changed the subject when money came up.
items.exampleZh: 一談到錢，他就不著痕跡地轉移話題。

items.exampleEn: I can control the lights remotely with my phone.
items.exampleZh: 我可以用手機遠端控制電燈。

items.exampleEn: The cafe has an eclectic menu, from Korean rice dishes to Italian pasta.
items.exampleZh: 這家咖啡館的菜單很多元，從韓式飯類到義大利麵都有。

items.exampleEn: The seat belt is adjustable for both children and adults.
items.exampleZh: 這條安全帶可以調整，小孩和大人都能用。

items.exampleEn: The muscles in his arms were taut after the long climb.
items.exampleZh: 長時間攀爬之後，他手臂的肌肉都緊繃著。

items.exampleEn: The closeness between the two sisters surprised everyone.
items.exampleZh: 那對姊妹之間的親密讓大家都很驚訝。

items.sentenceEn: The desk has an adjustable height, so you can sit or stand.
items.sentenceZh: 這張書桌的高度可以調整，所以你可以坐著或站著用。

items.audioEn: Many of our staff now work remotely three days a week.
items.audioZh: 我們很多員工現在每週有三天遠端工作。

items.sentenceEn: Pull the rope taut before you tie the knot.
items.sentenceZh: 打結之前，先把繩子拉緊。

items.sentenceEn: The colors in the painting change subtly as the light moves.
items.sentenceZh: 隨著光線移動，畫裡的顏色會微妙地變化。

items.stemEn: Her taste in music is ____: she listens to jazz, rock, and old folk songs.
items.stemZh: 她的音樂品味很多元：爵士、搖滾和老民謠她都聽。

items.stemEn: Her ____ to her grandmother was obvious from the way they laughed together.
items.stemZh: 從她和奶奶一起大笑的樣子，就看得出她們很親。

items.passageEn: When Lily moved into her first apartment, the living room felt somber: the walls were dark gray, and the curtains were heavy and brown. She decided to change it on a small budget. First, she discarded the heavy curtains. Then she painted the walls a soft yellow, which subtly made the room look bigger. After that, she filled it with an eclectic mix of furniture from street markets, including an old lamp with an adjustable arm. The hardest part was the cables behind the TV, which were a tangled mess. Now friends love to visit, and Lily says the room feels warm and welcoming.
items.passageZh: Lily 搬進她的第一間公寓時，客廳感覺很陰沉：牆壁是深灰色的，窗簾又厚重又是棕色的。她決定用不多的預算改造它。首先，她把厚重的窗簾丟了。接著，她把牆壁漆成柔和的黃色，不知不覺讓房間看起來比較大。之後，她擺進從街頭市集買來、風格多元的各式傢俱，其中包括一盞燈臂可以調整的舊檯燈。最難處理的是電視後面的電線，它們纏成一團亂。現在朋友們都喜歡來玩，Lily 說這個客廳感覺溫暖又舒適。

questions.questionZh: 一開始客廳給人什麼感覺？
改造中最難處理的是什麼？

items.promptZh: 我對運動一點興趣也沒有。
referenceEn: I'm not remotely interested in sports.
I am not even remotely interested in sports.
rubricZh: not remotely＋形容詞表示「一點也不」（例如 not remotely interested 等）

items.promptZh: 這支球隊的成功，來自球員之間的親密關係。
referenceEn: The team's success comes from the closeness between its players.
The closeness among the players is the reason for the team's success.
rubricZh: 「親密關係」用 closeness（例如 the closeness between the players 等）
「來自」可寫，例如 comes from、is the reason for、is due to 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 inexhaustible（本範圍 5 次）、structurally 為跨課重複，且詞性不合名詞位置，一眼可排除。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: inexhaustible、structurally 換成同單元名詞 simplicity、purity（Her ____ to her grandmother 不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（同課兩題 mcq 不共用干擾項）：adjustable 在 q13、q14 重複
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q14 的 adjustable 換成 eclectic

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（同課 mcq 不可拿另一題正解當干擾項）：q14 用了 q13 正解 eclectic
執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：closeness 例句「The closeness of the hotel to the beach was its best feature.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「親近、親密」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「The closeness between the two sisters surprised everyone.」示範第一義；釋義為「親近、親密；接近」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長新規則（只看英文）修正：只看英文時 adjustable 放進句中仍說得通（Her taste in music is adjustable）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: adjustable 換成 exterior（u04-l03；taste is exterior 語意不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：not remotely＋形容詞表示「一點也不」（例如 not remotely interested 等）／「運動」可寫，例如 sports、sport 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：closeness 是名詞，表示「親近、親密」（例如 the closeness I have with…、the closeness between… 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（closeness）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u04-l04-q17；目標字沿用 closeness
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這支球隊的成功，來自球員之間的親密關係。」、hintWords ["closeness"]、referenceEn ["The team's success comes from the closeness between its players.","The closeness among the players is the reason for the team's success."]、rubricZh ["「親密關係」用 closeness（例如 the closeness between the players 等）","「來自」可寫，例如 comes from、is the reason for、is due to 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 closeness 造一個句子，說說你和某個人之間的親近關係。」、referenceEn ["I value the closeness I have with my older sister.","The closeness between my best friend and me has lasted twenty years."]）
